tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (9.7:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: mountain-blue
tokens.usage: As primary, suggesting high-altitude authority. Used as text on `.stat-value`, `.btn-tertiary`. 9.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: mountain-blue-dark
tokens.usage: Declared in the style's palette. 8.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: mountain-blue-light
tokens.usage: Declared in the style's palette. 3.5:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: alpine-white
tokens.usage: Purity, space, snow, clarity, premium quality. Used as text on `.footer-links a`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: pure-white
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.header`, `.nav-link`, `.card-header`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: glacier-silver
tokens.usage: Technology, precision, modern elegance. Used as text on `.stat-card::before`. 1.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: pine-green
tokens.usage: Growth, sustainability, natural heritage, stability. Used as border on `.stat-card:hover`; text on `.stat-change`. 6.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: pine-light
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.footer-links a:hover, .footer-links a:focus`. 2.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: metal-gray
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.card-meta`, `.form-help`. 4.5:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: slate-dark
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.stat-label`, `.card-text`, `.data-table td`. 9.7:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: As primary, suggesting high-altitude authority. Used as shadow/glow on `.search-input:focus`, `.form-input:focus, .form-select:focus, .form-texta`.

tokens.name: color-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour: key actions and emphasis.
